blockers.reason: Routes without Go implementation or fail-closed gates remain on Laravel.

controls.description: Block Laravel-owned mutation traffic at the gateway during the approved window.
controls.name: gateway-mutation-block

controls.description: Drain Laravel queues before entering read-only and keep workers stopped during the window.
controls.name: queue-drain

controls.description: Pause Laravel scheduled jobs that can mutate data until archival is complete or rollback starts.
controls.name: scheduled-job-pause

controls.description: Verify Go-owned and Go fail-closed routes before read-only maintenance begins.
controls.name: go-route-verification

controls.description: Announce the time-boxed maintenance window and expected read-only behavior.
controls.name: operator-broadcast

exit_criteria: No Laravel schema freeze violations exist.
No unresolved route cutover blockers exist.
Laravel queues are drained and workers are stopped.
Go-owned routes pass the staging smoke plan.
Rollback owner and gateway switchback command are confirmed.
redaction: The maintenance plan records only aggregate status and control names. It contains no credentials, cookies, authorization headers, or payload data.

rollback.strategy: Remove the gateway mutation block, resume Laravel workers and scheduled jobs, and route traffic back to Laravel before retrying the handover.
